title: Pure Skyscraper
summary: Jaden Yuki's Skyscraper strategy revolves around the iconic Field Spells Skyscraper (which gives an attacking Elemental HERO +1000 ATK when battling a stronger monster) and Skyscraper 2 - Hero City (which revives an Elemental HERO destroyed by battle every turn), modernized by Elemental HERO Flame Wingman - Infernal Rage and Favorite Hero! Fusion Summon Infernal Rage using Stratos + Liquid Soldier (or Blazeman) to search Favorite Hero (or Favorite Contact) and tribute Infernal Rage to summon Elemental HERO Sunrise (which searches Miracle Fusion for Elemental HERO Shining Neos Wingman or original Flame Wingman!). Equip Favorite Hero to your HERO boss: at the start of the Battle Phase, Favorite Hero activates Skyscraper directly from your hand or Deck, gives your HERO +ATK equal to its original DEF, makes it untargetable by opponent's card effects, and lets it attack twice!

allow.Polymerization: Searched by Elemental HERO Blazeman and recycled by Wonder Driver to Fusion Summon Elemental HERO Flame Wingman - Infernal Rage or Sunrise.
allow.Miracle Fusion: Searched by Elemental HERO Sunrise on Special Summon: banishes Elemental HERO materials from your field or GY to Fusion Summon Elemental HERO Shining Neos Wingman, Flame Wingman, or Absolute Zero!
allow.E - Emergency Call: Normal Spell that adds any 'Elemental HERO' monster (Stratos, Captain Gold, Liquid Soldier, or Blazeman) from your Deck to your hand.
allow.A Hero Lives: Pays half your LP while you control no face-up monsters to Special Summon Elemental HERO Stratos or Blazeman directly from your Deck.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Elemental HERO Stratos, Liquid Soldier, or Captain Gold.
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Skyscraper or Skyscraper 2 - Hero City.
allow.Xtra HERO Wonder Driver: Link-2 LIGHT Warrior HERO that resets Polymerization, Miracle Fusion, or Favorite Contact from your GY whenever a HERO is summoned to its arrow.

main: Elemental HERO Captain Gold

Signature Skyscraper searcher (Level 4 LIGHT Warrior, 2100 ATK): discards itself from your hand to the GY to add 1 'Skyscraper' from your Deck to your hand (and provides a LIGHT material in the GY for Miracle Fusion into Elemental HERO Sunrise or The Shining!).
Elemental HERO Stratos

Core Level 4 WIND Warrior starter: adds any 'HERO' monster from your Deck to your hand on Normal or Special Summon, or destroys Spells/Traps on the field up to the number of other HERO monsters you control.
Elemental HERO Liquid Soldier

Level 4 WATER Warrior: revives a Level 4 or lower HERO (like Blazeman or Stratos) from your GY on Normal Summon, and lets you draw 2 cards and discard 1 when used as Fusion Material for a HERO Fusion Monster!
Elemental HERO Blazeman
Level 4 FIRE Warrior: adds 1 'Polymerization' from your Deck to your hand on Normal or Special Summon, or sends an Elemental HERO (like Neos or Sparkman) from your Deck to the GY.
Elemental HERO Shadow Mist
Level 4 DARK Warrior: adds any 'HERO' monster from your Deck to your hand when sent to the GY (such as when used as Fusion Material!).
Elemental HERO Neos
Level 7 LIGHT Warrior (2500 ATK / 2000 DEF): dumped by Blazeman or used for Favorite Contact into Elemental HERO Shining Neos Wingman.
Elemental HERO Avian
Classic WIND Normal HERO required in GY/banishment to summon original Flame Wingman via Favorite Contact or Infernal Rage.
Elemental HERO Burstinatrix
Classic FIRE Normal HERO required for original Elemental HERO Flame Wingman.
Skyscraper

Iconic Field Spell (searchable by Captain Gold and activated from Deck by Favorite Hero!): whenever an 'Elemental HERO' monster attacks a monster with higher ATK, the attacking monster gains 1000 ATK during damage calculation only!
Skyscraper 2 - Hero City

Companion Field Spell (activatable directly from your Deck by Favorite Hero!): once per turn during your Main Phase, Special Summons 1 'Elemental HERO' monster from your GY that was destroyed by battle!
Favorite Hero

Core Equip Spell (searched by Flame Wingman - Infernal Rage!): while a card is in your Field Zone (Skyscraper!), the equipped Level 5+ HERO gains ATK equal to its original DEF (+1200 to +2500 ATK!) and cannot be targeted by opponent's card effects; at the start of the Battle Phase, activates 1 Field Spell (Skyscraper or Skyscraper 2!) directly from your hand or Deck; and sends itself to the GY when destroying a monster by battle to grant a second attack!
Skydive Scorcher

Signature Skyscraper Normal Spell: targets 1 Elemental HERO Fusion Monster you control to destroy all monsters your opponent controls with higher ATK than that monster and inflict burn damage equal to the highest original ATK—or the COMBINED original ATK of all destroyed monsters if 'Skyscraper' is in your Field Zone!
Polymerization
Fuses 2 Elemental HEROes into Flame Wingman - Infernal Rage or Sunrise.
Miracle Fusion
Searched by Elemental HERO Sunrise: banishes Elemental HEROes from your GY to Fusion Summon Shining Neos Wingman, Absolute Zero, or Flame Wingman.
E - Emergency Call
Searches Stratos, Captain Gold, Liquid Soldier, or Blazeman.
A Hero Lives
Special Summons Elemental HERO Stratos directly from your Deck without using your Normal Summon.
Favorite Contact

Normal Trap (searched by Infernal Rage!): places materials from your hand, field, GY, and/or banishment on the bottom of the Deck to Special Summon Elemental HERO Shining Neos Wingman or Flame Wingman from your Extra Deck (ignoring its summoning conditions!).
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Stratos or Captain Gold.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Skyscraper or Skyscraper 2 - Hero City.
extra: Elemental HERO Flame Wingman - Infernal Rage

Core Level 6 WIND Warrior Fusion (2 'Elemental HERO' monsters with different Attributes): searches ANY 'Favorite' card (Favorite Hero or Favorite Contact!) on Special Summon, and tributes itself (if Fusion Summoned using a Normal Monster) to Special Summon a Level 7 or lower Elemental HERO from your Deck or Extra Deck!

Core Level 7 LIGHT Warrior Fusion (2 'HERO' monsters with different Attributes; 2500 ATK): searches 'Miracle Fusion' on Special Summon, boosts all monsters you control by 200 ATK per Attribute you control, and destroys 1 card on the field whenever another HERO declares an attack!

Signature Level 8 LIGHT Warrior Fusion boss ('Elemental HERO Neos' + 1 'Wingman' Fusion Monster; 3100 ATK + 2500 DEF from Favorite Hero = 5600 ATK!): cannot be destroyed by card effects; destroys cards your opponent controls on Special Summon up to the number of different Attributes on the field, gains 300 ATK per monster in your GY, and inflicts burn damage on battle destruction!

Jaden's iconic Skyscraper champion ('Elemental HERO Avian' + 'Elemental HERO Burstinatrix'; 2100 ATK + 1000 from Skyscraper + 1200 from Favorite Hero = 4300 ATK!): inflicts burn damage equal to the destroyed monster's original ATK whenever it destroys a monster by battle!
Level 8 WATER Warrior Fusion (1 HERO + 1 WATER monster: Liquid Soldier!) that destroys all monsters your opponent controls when it leaves the field.

Level 8 WIND Warrior Fusion (1 Elemental HERO + 1 WIND monster: Stratos!) that halves the ATK and DEF of all face-up monsters your opponent controls so your HEROes easily run them over under Skyscraper.
Link-2 LIGHT Warrior HERO that resets Polymerization, Miracle Fusion, or Favorite Contact from your GY.
